nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Kể chuyện · bài tự soạn
kind: Chuyện xui: bánh sinh nhật gặp mất điện
L: Okay, you won't believe what happened this weekend!
I was baking a cake for my mom's birthday when the power went out.
The cake was half cooked, and the kitchen was completely dark.
I used my phone as a flashlight, but I dropped it into the flour.
Then my little brother walked in and asked what the smell was.
When the lights came back on, the cake looked like a pancake!
We were laughing so hard that Mom came to see what was going on.
She ate a piece anyway and said it was the best pancake ever.
Honestly, I'm never baking in the dark again!

exq.q: Why did Mom come into the kitchen?
